query_cases.query: Trace the lineage from ReAct agents to BrowseComp evaluation benchmarks then compare citation verification stages.
query_cases.model_answer: ReAct interleaved reasoning and action traces [1], which later informed web-browsing evaluation in BrowseComp [2] and atomic claim verification with MiniCheck [3].
evidence_snippets: ReAct prompts language models to generate reasoning traces and task-specific actions.
BrowseComp evaluates multi-hop browsing agents on persistent web search queries.
MiniCheck verifies atomic claims against retrieved grounding passages.

query_cases.query: Compare unified memory bandwidth versus PCIe VRAM capacity for local 70B Q4 inference workstations.
query_cases.model_answer: Apple M4 Max provides 546 GB/s unified memory up to 128 GB [1], whereas dual RTX 4090 configurations offer higher peak compute bandwidth across 48 GB total VRAM [2].
evidence_snippets: M4 Max unified memory reaches 546 GB/s with 128 GB capacity for single-box 70B Q4 weights.
Dual RTX 4090 systems provide 48 GB GDDR6X at 1008 GB/s per card over PCIe.

query_cases.query: FRAMES-style: trace VoxDb research_session_sources upsert then verify cursor pagination ordering.
query_cases.model_answer: VoxDb stores deduplicated rows in research_session_sources [1] and paginates them via list_session_sources_page ordered by id ASC [2].
evidence_snippets: INSERT INTO research_session_sources ON CONFLICT(session_id, url) DO UPDATE keeps the highest relevance_score.
list_session_sources_page queries WHERE session_id = ?1 AND id > ?2 ORDER BY id ASC.

query_cases.query: Compare OpenAlex work graph indexing with CrossRef DOI registration for automated prior-art novelty bundles.
query_cases.model_answer: OpenAlex indexes scholarly works and citation counts [1], while CrossRef resolves authoritative DOI metadata [2].
evidence_snippets: OpenAlex provides open bibliographic work graphs and citation counts.
CrossRef maintains authoritative DOI registration metadata for scholarly publishers.
